Use this skill whenever the user wants to interact with Memos: creating, listing, updating, or deleting notes; managing tags, comments, reactions, or relations; uploading attachments; or managing shares. Even if the user just says "check my notes", "add a comment", "pin that", "show my tags", "what did I write about X", or "capture this thought", use this skill. All API calls go through secure scripts that handle authentication and sanitize credentials automatically. Memos works as a timeline (not a folder-based notebook) — use tags to organize notes instead of directories.
